scope: Exploratory variant of the existing research B. Only ordered 1-2 dependence changes. Both individual marginals and every P(third | ordered pair) are fixed.
labels: Earlier archived official complete podium. Train through 2026-05-23; disjoint archived forecast evaluation 2026-05-24 to 2026-11-20. Use completeness of original line only at forecast time. Original rolling outcomes used by earlier folds are not presented as a fresh prospective holdout.
features: win probability gap within same line
combined line win probability for opposing riders
win probability gap for opposing riders
training: Exactly constrained log-linear pair likelihood with L2 0.02; derivatives after conserving both marginals. No evaluation tuning. Infer with complete pre-cutoff original B probabilities. Exclude absent, malformed or unstructured lines from adjustment and keep original picks.
testing: Compare equal 1/4/8 and as-published caps. Paired day resampling, ordered first-two coverage, observed same/cross groups, timestamped card subset, held-out fixed cutoff races. This alternative never changes live picks or approval gates.
